cronjobs.markdownDescription:
Scheduled jobs that ship with this workload. CronJobs share main ConfigMap and Secret env sources by default.
Set `inheritEnvFrom: false` to opt out.

Example:
```yaml
cronjobs:
  - name: cleanup
    schedule: "0 2 * * *"
    image:
      repository: busybox
      tag: 1.36.1
    command: ["/bin/sh", "-c"]
    args: ["echo cleanup"]
    inheritEnvFrom: true
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 25m
        memory: 64Mi
```

name.description: Existing platform ConfigMap name to import when platformConfig.data is empty. Defaults to <fullname>-platform-config when data is set.

data.description: Platform/runtime configuration data for the application ConfigMap. A ConfigMap is created when this map is non-empty.
data.markdownDescription: Free-form map with string values. Good for labels, annotations, selectors, and string data.

template.description: Templated YAML map merged into platformConfig.data. Useful for generated config keys.
